description: Cutoffs on Jev's probability-weighted Score (expected level, 0-4): level = number of cutoffs <= score. Fitted to maximize quadratic-weighted kappa with the saved DeepSeek V4.1 Flash levels on the 500-answer samples (artifacts/jev-recon-v2/judge-sample.json, sample.json). Validated by fitting on 4 checkpoints and testing on the other 4 (JUDGE M kappa 0.76 -> 0.88; RECONSTRUCT T 0.67 -> 0.74, P 0.65 -> 0.68, E 0.61 -> 0.63, M 0.71 -> 0.72). Only valid for the question wording in src/anlp_project/jev_judging.py.
